sentences.text: Terminator Genisys is a 2015 American science fiction action film directed by Alan Taylor and written by Laeta Kalogridis and Patrick Lussier .	Alan Taylor	Alan Taylor (director)	Laeta Kalogridis	Laeta Kalogridis	Patrick Lussier	Patrick Lussier	science fiction	science fiction	action film	action film

The fifth installment in the Terminator franchise , it serves as a soft reboot to the film series that features the main characters from the first two films , portrayed by a new cast with the exception of Arnold Schwarzenegger , who reprises his role as the eponymous character .	Arnold Schwarzenegger	Arnold Schwarzenegger	soft reboot	Reboot_(fiction)#Soft_reboot	eponymous character	Terminator (character)
The film stars Schwarzenegger , Jason Clarke , Emilia Clarke and Jai Courtney .	Jason Clarke	Jason Clarke	Emilia Clarke	Emilia Clarke	Jai Courtney	Jai Courtney

The plot follows soldier Kyle Reese in the war against Skynet ; Kyle is sent from the year 2029 to 1984 by John Connor , leader of the Human Resistance , to protect Connor 's mother Sarah from Skynet 's android agent .	Kyle Reese	Kyle Reese	Skynet	Skynet (Terminator)	John Connor	John Connor	Sarah	Sarah Connor (Terminator)

When Kyle arrives in the past , he discovers that the timeline has been altered and Sarah has been raised by his quarry 's reprogrammed facsimile , and must travel to 2017 to stop a dangerous scheme from Skynet and face its advanced enforcer , the T-3000 , with his new allies .	Skynet	Skynet (Terminator)	Sarah	Sarah Connor (Terminator)	the timeline has been altered	Alternate history	T-3000	T-3000
Megan Ellison and her production company , Annapurna Pictures , acquired the franchise rights in May 2011 .	Megan Ellison	Megan Ellison	Annapurna Pictures	Annapurna Pictures

The following year , production of another installment in the series was set up in collaboration with Skydance Productions -LRB- owned by Ellison 's brother , David -RRB- .	Skydance Productions	Skydance Productions	David	David Ellison

The Ellisons consulted Terminator creator James Cameron in the hope of returning to the spirit of the original film , The Terminator , and its sequel , Terminator 2 : Judgment Day .	James Cameron	James Cameron	The Terminator	The Terminator
Principal photography was primarily in New Orleans , with some in the on-screen setting of San Francisco .	New Orleans	New Orleans	San Francisco	San Francisco

Six companies handled the film 's visual effects ; its prosthetic make-up and animatronics were created by Legacy Effects , a studio founded by Terminator veteran Stan Winston .	visual effects	visual effects	Legacy Effects	Legacy Effects	Stan Winston	Stan Winston
The film was released by Paramount Pictures on July 1 , 2015 , in standard digital format , RealD 3D , and IMAX 3D .	Paramount Pictures	Paramount Pictures	RealD 3D	RealD 3D	IMAX 3D	IMAX 3D
Terminator Genisys was not well received by critics , who found the story and performances unsatisfactory , although Schwarzenegger 's return to the franchise was praised .
It grossed over $ 440 million worldwide , making it the second-highest-grossing film of the franchise and Schwarzenegger 's career -LRB- after Terminator 2 : Judgment Day -RRB- .
